 R/O village Kota Macharhedi
 P.S. Jwalapur, District Hardwar....... Respondents

Sri Manish Arora, Advocate for the respondents 2 & 3
Sri Suhel Siddequi, Additional Govt. Advocate.

Dated: 9.8.2005
Hon'ble Rajesh Tandon J.
 By the present writ petition the petitioner has prayed a
writ in the nature of Habeas Corpus directing the respondents
no. 2 and 3 to produce the wife of the petitioner Smt. Sonia in
safe and sound condition before this Court. Further Prayer is
made for a writ of mandamus directing the respondents no.2
and 3 to handover safe and sound custody of Smt. Sonia to the
petitioner.

Briefly stated, Smt. Sonia is major and her date of birth is
14.11.1981. She has passed M.A. in the year 2002. The petitioner
has submitted that the respondents no. 2 and 3 and other
family members of Smt. Sonia were deadly against the marriage
of the petitioner and Smt. Sonia. The petitioner and Smt. Sonia
has solemnized marriage in a temple at Sonipat on 12.10.2002.
They have also got their marriage registered with the Registrar,
Hindu Marriage, Roorkee on 12.5.2005.
 The petitioner has submitted that on 29.6.2005 in the
absence of petitioner, respondents no.2 and 3 came at the
residence of the petitioner and against the consent of Smt.
Sonia forcibly took her with them. The petitioner has
approached the Police but police have declined to interfere in
the matter, since then Smt. Sonia is in illegal detention of the
respondents no. 2 and 3 and her life is in danger.
 The petitioner has also filed a supplementary affidavit
enclosing a letter of Smt. Sonia addressed to the petitioner
Sanjeev Kaushik. This letter read over to Smt. Sonia in the Court
and she has stated that it is not possible for her to live with
her parents. She has also written that her father has beaten her.
 Both husband and wife were examined by the Additional
Registrar Smt. Meena Tiwari. The Additional Registrar
examined both Smt. Sonia and Sri Sanjeev Kaushik separately.
Smt. Sonia in her statement before the Additional Registrar has
stated that she was married with Sanjeev Kaushik with her own
free will. She was preparing for civil service examination at
Dehradun with her husband. If she is asked to go with her
parents, there may be some serious incident and her parents
will detain her. She did not want to go with her parents. She
may be sent along with her husband from the court itself.

Similarly Sri Sanjeev Kaushik has stated in his statement
that they were in love since the year 1998 and they married in
the year 2002. The parents and family members of Smt. Sonia
were against their marriage and they opposed their marriage.
On 29th June 2005 when he went to Delhi in connection with
his business, the parents of Smt. Sonia came to his residence
and forcibly took Smt. Sonia with them and since then she is
detained by them.
 Smt. Meena Tiwari, Additional Registrar has also made
the following note on the order sheet:
"Both Mrs. Sonia Saini and Sri Sanjeev Kaushik are
present before me. Both parties' learned counsel are also
present but both the lawyers want to record and conversation
in their absence, so as per circumstances of the case both the
lawyers are not present at the time talk with parties. I asked
the parties separately about the matter and also recorded
statements separately. The petitioner and Ms. Sonia both
agreed that they are married and living as husband and wife
and Ms. Sonia wants to go with her husband Sri Sanjeev
Kaushik. The sealed envelop is kept with file in which the
recorded statements are placed.
 This is my report. Submitted".
Smt. Sonia is personally present in the Court. She has
stated that she has made the statement before the Additional
Registrar voluntarily and she wants to go and live with her
husband. She was detained in her parent's house against her
will.
 I have examined the entire material on record and have
perused the statements of both the parties. From the documents

on record it is evident that the age of Smt. Sonia is 24 years and
the age of Sri Sanjeev Kaushik is 32 years. Both the parties have
solemnized marriage in the year 2002 and they were living
together as husband and wife. They have also got their marriage
registered before the Registrar, Hindu Marriage, Roorkee on
12.5.2005. The respondents no. 2 and 3 have illegally detained
Smt. Sonia in their house against her will and thus the writ
petition for habeas corpus is liable to allowed.
 As will appear from the aforesaid facts, the petitioner has
been successful in proving the illegal and wrongful detention of
Smt. Sonia by the respondents no. 2 and 3. Consequently, the
respondents having produced Smt. Sonia before the Court, she
is allowed to go along with her husband according to her own
will. The respondent no. 1 is directed to ensure the safety of
Smt. Sonia and her husband by providing them sufficient police
protection.
 Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed. Let copy of this
order be issued to the petitioner today.
9.8.2005 Rajesh Tandon J.
*Dhyani
